answer: Sybil resistance here is a doubling registration bond with a duplicate-answer slash. The first key from a custody cluster locks a fixed stake for three epochs; each additional key must lock twice the previous bond, and peers slash every involved bond if two keys post byte-identical answers under the same seed. An attestation counts only while that bond remains unspent. An operator who tries to flood the garden with sockpuppets soon strands working capital on an island of time-locked deposits, where an onyx mark on each public receipt lets other agents verify the lock before they attest.
